interpretation: Source-prefix sweep: reconstruction R² as a function of how many layers' sources are available (ℓ≤ℓ_max), with the SSM free to propagate them forward. ℓ_max=0 is the pre-registered embedding-only lower bound — and since v_0 has no SAE (u_0=0 in every available dictionary), it is the example-independent floor: with no source to inject, the input-free state trajectory is the same for every example. The curve's rise with ℓ_max measures how much each band of per-layer sources is load-bearing; if it only saturates near ℓ_max=L-1, late-layer sources (Geva et al.'s built-up features) carry real, non-propagable reconstruction value. Complement of the use_state=False ablation (keeps sources, kills propagation).
